Here2Help

Here2Help: Real help. Right here. Right now 
What it is:
A simple SMS chatbot designed to help underserved Tulsa residents—particularly those in North and East Tulsa neighborhoods—who face extreme summer heat, food insecurity, and lack access to safe medication disposal options.

Who the end users are:

Adults and seniors with limited or no smartphone/internet access

Residents experiencing heat stress without air conditioning or cooling centers nearby

Individuals and families with limited transportation options

People who may be managing leftover opioid medications but lack safe disposal info

Communities with limited trust or awareness of existing public resources

How it works:
Users text ChatOx, select their immediate need, provide their ZIP code, and receive localized info about available services. The chatbot offers follow-up alerts and logs interactions for city agencies to identify hotspots and allocate resources proactively.

Why it matters:
This tool reaches people often excluded from digital solutions, providing critical information and support to vulnerable populations while generating data to drive equitable resource deployment.

Tech overview:

SMS Bot - Build and test the SMS chatbot flow, load resource data, and connect the backend database. Use early data to inform development of an agency-facing dashboard.
